wiki.title: Amaad Rivera-Wagner
wiki.extract: Amaad Rivera-Wagner (born December 1981) is an American community organizer and Democratic politician from Green Bay, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 90th Assembly district since 2025. He has served as chief of staff to Green Bay mayor Eric Genrich since 2021, and managed Genrich's 2023 re-election campaign. Earlier in his career, he was the first openly gay member of the City Council of Springfield, Massachusetts, served as a policy advisor to United States senator Ed Markey (D–MA), and ran for Massachusetts Senate.
